script: In Japan, you can legally sue your spouse's affair partner. This ruthless approach to infidelity is built right into the civil code. Betrayed husbands and wives hire lawyers to demand consolation money directly from the homewrecker. You will see law firms advertising these exact settlement services on city billboards. This legal threat fuels a massive public surveillance industry. Private detectives openly plaster their faces on commuter train windows, offering to hunt down cheating spouses. Investigators trail targets through neon streets with long-lens cameras, waiting to snap the required photo of them entering a love hotel. But the craziest part is the professional break-up industry. Scorned spouses hire undercover actors to physically seduce the affair partner. They secretly film this new romance to legally destroy the illicit relationship and force a permanent split.
title: The Great Emu War
